roles.functionStatement: Establish the status and needs of wildlife populations and habitats and advise decisions that affect them.

x4.reviewStatus: unreviewed agent candidate (not reviewed by a person)

bands.indicativeBand: GS-5 to GS-7 (entry); GS-9 to GS-11 (journey)

majorDuties.duty: Capture, handle and mark wildlife and fish humanely and safely

tasks.statement: Capture animals with traps, nets or electrofishing following the approved animal-care protocol and permit conditions
Immobilize an animal chemically where authorized, monitoring vital signs until recovery and recording drug doses
Mark captured animals with tags or other marks while recording biological data within protocol handling-time and stress limits
Apply zoonotic disease and personal safety precautions when handling wildlife, including protective equipment and decontamination

majorDuties.duty: Detect and record wildlife by direct observation, sign and standardized surveys

tasks.statement: Deploy camera traps and acoustic recorders at survey stations to the protocol's height, orientation and settings, recording station metadata
Conduct ground or aerial counts of target species along defined survey units to support abundance estimation
Conduct point-count, transect or call-playback wildlife surveys to protocol, recording detections, distance bands and survey conditions

majorDuties.duty: Assess species habitat requirements and habitat condition

tasks.statement: Measure habitat attributes such as cover, structure, water and forage at used and available sites following a habitat-use study protocol
Integrate habitat findings into land-use or project plans as specific measures that avoid or reduce effects on species of concern
Observe animal movement, foraging and breeding behaviour at study sites, recording behaviour and habitat context on standardized forms

majorDuties.duty: Identify organisms from field characters, specimens, images and recordings

tasks.statement: Identify regional plants and animals to species with dichotomous keys and diagnostic features, collecting evidence for any record not identified with certainty
Verify species records submitted by crews or volunteers against attached photos, recordings or vouchers before they enter the program database

majorDuties.duty: Assess effects on protected species and conduct interagency consultation on proposed actions

tasks.statement: Compile species and habitat occurrence information for an action area, documenting the sources and survey dates used for each listed species
Prepare a biological assessment for a proposed action, stating the effects determination for each listed species and critical habitat with supporting evidence

majorDuties.duty: Design monitoring and sampling for valid environmental inference

tasks.statement: Choose the mix of field, sensor, remote-sensing and community methods for a monitoring programme from cost, detection and comparability evidence.
Estimate the power of a monitoring design to detect a specified change over a stated period, revising the design when power is insufficient.

majorDuties.duty: Adjudicate automated species detections using field-formed identification expertise

tasks.statement: Estimate false-positive and false-negative rates of an automated detector on a verified local validation set, reporting rates by species
Reject automated detections that are implausible for the place, season or habitat, stating the ecological reason for each rejection

majorDuties.duty: Analyze environmental data statistically and interpret the results

tasks.statement: Estimate treatment effects on ecological response variables with a method suited to the design, reporting effect sizes and intervals.
Analyze trends in a long-term monitoring dataset, accounting for changes in methods, effort and detection over the record.

majorDuties.duty: Assess and monitor biodiversity across species and habitats

tasks.statement: Implement a multi-taxon biodiversity monitoring protocol at assigned sites, coordinating crews, passive detectors and sample collection to schedule
Analyze long-term biodiversity monitoring data to estimate change in occupancy or richness against conservation objectives, stating uncertainty

majorDuties.duty: Navigate and travel safely in remote terrain with and without digital aids

tasks.statement: Record field locations with a satellite positioning receiver to the protocol's accuracy, logging signal quality and averaging positions where required
Check field location data against field notes and maps before transfer, correcting or flagging points with implausible positions
